text: dsh-vivado 为 Windows DSH 桌面版提供 Vivado/FPGA 会话预设与随包技能。它通过 DSH bundle 注册 Vivado 预设并挂载工作流、仿真和 AMD 文档检索技能。完整 kit 安装器会注册 profile；独立预设子包可用 dsh plugin add 安装，但不含 vivado-mcp 工具。适合希望在 DSH 中获得 FPGA 工作流指导的 Vivado 用户。完整 kit 需另备 Vivado 和第三方 vivado-mcp；文档检索会将查询发送到 AMD 托管服务。

dsh-vivado adds a Vivado/FPGA preset and skills to DSH desktop. It registers workflow, simulation, and AMD documentation search skills. The installer registers a profile; the standalone preset omits vivado-mcp tools. The full kit needs Vivado and third-party vivado-mcp. Search queries go to AMD.
想让 DSH 会话按 Vivado/FPGA 工程流程给我操作建议。
我想在 DSH 里查 AMD 官方的 Vivado 文档。
Help me use a DSH session for Vivado FPGA simulation workflows.
dsh-vivado 的「Vivado 会话预设」将 FPGA persona、DSH 工具插件和随包技能组合为可选会话，用于获得 Vivado 工程工作流指导。
dsh-vivado 的功能「AMD 文档检索」：随包的 amd-doc-search 技能可按 Vivado、Vitis、器件及相关文档主题检索 AMD 官方资料，并返回 docs.amd.com 链接供引用。

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

一条命令 + 一次重启，给 DeepSeek Harness 装上「Vivado 专用开发环境」：
一个带工程纪律的会话预设、32 个直接驱动 Vivado 的工具、8 个官方/自研技能。

装上之后，你可以直接对助手说人话：「打开 `my_proj.xpr`，看综合状态和资源」「用 `xdc_lint` 查约束」
「跑综合，起完别等我，轮询进度」——它会自己按顺序复用既有结果、只在必要时才真正启动综合/实现。

> 本仓库**不含** Vivado 本体与许可证、不含 AMD 账号/entitlement、不含任何密钥；也**不代签**任何 AMD 协议。
> 你需要自备合法的 Vivado 安装与许可，以及第三方项目 [`vivado-mcp`](https://github.com/mapleleavessssssss-wq/vivado-mcp)。

|---|---|
| 一个叫 **`Vivado`** 的会话预设 | 新建会话时选它（默认仍是 `standard`）。它把「先读工程 → `xdc_lint` → 复用既有综合/实现结果 → 确实必要时才综合」这套顺序，以及「路径必须 ASCII、Vivado 全局串行、结论必须带证据」这类纪律写进了助手的行为准则 |
| **32 个** `mcp__vivado__*` 工具 | 综合/实现、时序、利用率、CDC、XDC 检查、ILA 波形、会话管理等，全部通过 stdio MCP 直连本机 Vivado（第三方 `vivado-mcp` 提供） |
| **8 个技能** | AMD 官方 6 件（RTL 综合日志分析、lint、仿真、版本管理、ILA、VIO，MIT）+ 2 件自研（AMD 文档检索、Vivado 工作流纪律）。**随包挂载，不往你的 `~/.dsh/skills` 写任何文件** |
| **3 个随包运行脚本** | `tools/vivado-probe.ps1`（可靠探活，`vivado.bat -version` 不算）、`tools/vivado-run.ps1`（batch 运行；`-Detach` 起脱离进程树的长构建）、`tools/tcl-check.ps1`（用 Vivado 自带的 8.5.14 解释器做 Tcl 语法门禁）。会话里不必每次现写启动命令，也不会踩 `cmd /c` 二次套引号 |
| 体检与干净的卸载 | `doctor.ps1` 13 项逐条 PASS/WARN/FAIL 并给一句修法；`uninstall.ps1` 还原 profile 并清掉自己装的目录 |

dsh-vivado README · 装完你会得到什么：**适合谁**：Windows 上做 Xilinx/AMD FPGA、已经在用 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版、希望助手能真正操作 Vivado 而不是只在对话里出主意的人。

**不适合谁**：不想装第三方 MCP、或工程处在必须断网/NDA 环境（文档检索技能会把查询发往 AMD 服务，默认可以不装它）。

dsh-vivado README · 前置条件：| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 操作系统 | Windows 10 / 11 |
| DeepSeek Harness | **桌面版 ≥ 0.2.2-rc.1**（Electron 宿主） |
| Vivado | 已安装、`vivado.bat` 可跑。**2023.1 已实测**；2025.2+ 未实测（见[版本档位](#版本档位)） |
| Python | **≥ 3.10**（`vivado-mcp` 0.3.26 要求；用你跑 `vivado-mcp` 的那个解释器即可） |

dsh-vivado README · 装完怎么用：1. 新建会话 → 预设选 **`Vivado`**（`standard` 会话是没有 `mcp__vivado__*` 工具的，这是故意的）。
2. 一句话自检：
   - 「列出你工具清单里所有 `mcp__vivado__*`」→ 应该是 **32** 个；
   - 「列一下你能看到的技能」→ 应该是 **8** 个；
   - 「你的系统提示里有没有 `Vivado is GLOBALLY SERIAL` 这句」→ 应该是「有」。
3. 然后就像平时一样说人话，例如：
   - 「打开 `D:\work\prj\project_1.xpr`，看综合状态和资源利用率」
   - 「用 `xdc_lint` 检查 `constraints_1`，要全量明细」
   - 「跑综合，`wait=false` 起，然后每轮报一次进度」
4. 长任务不用干等：`run_synthesis` / `run_implementation` 用 `wait: false` 起，再用 `get_run_progress` 轮询。

dsh-vivado README · 出问题了：先跑体检，它会把「哪一项坏了、怎么修」直接打出来：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\doctor.ps1
```

最常见的四类（完整清单见 [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](docs/troubleshooting.md)）：

dsh-vivado README · 出问题了：| 症状 | 先做什么 |
|---|---|
| 重启后看不到 `Vivado` 预设 | 确认真的重启过；确认装到的是你打开的那个 profile（`-Profile`）；再跑 `doctor.ps1` 看第 9/10 项 |
| 预设有了，但一个 `mcp__vivado__*` 都没有（含"DSH 刚自动升级后"） | 多半是 profile 缺 `compatibility.json` 版本豁免 → 重跑 `install.ps1`（**别带** `-SkipCompatibility`）后重启；`doctor.ps1` 第 12 项会直接点名 |
| `start_session` 失败 / Tcl 报 `File not found` | 几乎都是**非 ASCII 路径**；`doctor.ps1` 第 5 项会点名是哪个配置键 |
| `xdc_lint` / `get_cdc_report` 明细被截断 | 没打 `patches/vivado-mcp` 的补丁（默认不自动打），见 [`patches/vivado-mcp/README.md`](patches/vivado-mcp/README.md) |
dsh-vivado README · 出问题了：三条铁律值得先记住：**改配置必须重启**、**所有 Vivado 路径必须 ASCII**、**同一时刻只跑一个 Vivado**。

| 档 | 你会得到的口径 |
|---|---|
| `2023.1`（`< 2025.2`） | 本档**实测**事实：Tcl 8.5.14、`open_project -noprogress` 不存在、ILA `C_DATA_DEPTH` 最小 1024、`report_*` 参数按 2023.1 查 |
| `2025.2+` | **一条实测都没有**：所有版本相关事实都要求助手先探测再用，并如实标注量到的值 |

dsh-vivado README · What you get：| You get | Details |
|---|---|
| A session preset named **`Vivado`** | Pick it when you create a session (the default stays `standard`). It teaches the assistant the order "read the project → `xdc_lint` → reuse existing synthesis/implementation results → only then run a build", plus rules such as "every Vivado path must be ASCII", "Vivado is globally serial", "every conclusion carries evidence" |
| **32** `mcp__vivado__*` tools | Synthesis and implementation, timing, utilization, CDC, XDC linting, ILA waveforms, session management — all through a stdio MCP server that talks to your local Vivado (provided by the third-party `vivado-mcp`) |
| **8 skills** | Six AMD official skills (RTL elaboration-log analysis, lint, simulation, revision control, ILA, VIO; MIT) and two first-party ones (AMD documentation search, Vivado workflow discipline). They are **mounted from this package — nothing is written into your `~/.dsh/skills`** |
| A health check and a clean uninstall | `doctor.ps1` runs 13 checks with PASS/WARN/FAIL and a one-line fix each; `uninstall.ps1` restores your profile and removes what it installed |

dsh-vivado README · What you get：**Who this is for**: people doing Xilinx/AMD FPGA work on Windows who already use the DeepSeek Harness
desktop app and want the assistant to actually operate Vivado instead of only talking about it.

**Who this is not for**: setups that refuse a third-party MCP server, or NDA / air-gapped projects —
the documentation-search skill sends its query to AMD's hosted service (it is optional and can be left unused).

dsh-vivado README · Prerequisites：| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 10 / 11 |
| DeepSeek Harness | **desktop app ≥ 0.2.2-rc.1** (the Electron host) |
| Vivado | installed and `vivado.bat` runnable. **2023.1 is tested**; 2025.2+ is untested (see [Version tiers](#version-tiers)) |
| Python | **≥ 3.10** (`vivado-mcp` 0.3.26 requires it) — use the interpreter that runs `vivado-mcp` |
| vivado-mcp | `pip install vivado-mcp==0.3.26` into an **ASCII-only directory**, and `import vivado_mcp` must work |
| Paths | project root, `TEMP`, `TMP` and the vivado-mcp install path must be **pure ASCII** (Vivado's Tcl layer decodes paths as GBK and breaks on anything else) |
| License | your own valid Vivado license |

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1

The installer detects your Vivado / Python / vivado-mcp locations; you only confirm the `part`

```

dsh-vivado README · Install：**Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards.** The profile and bundle patches are read at host startup,
and the Electron host has no hot reload — this is a precondition, not a suggestion. Then create a new
session and switch the preset to **`Vivado`**.

dsh-vivado README · Install：> **Updating an existing install**: quit the desktop app completely, then `git pull` and re-run
> `install.ps1` (idempotent). While the host runs, the official CLI refuses to manage the desktop
> profile on purpose. See [`docs/install.md` §1.5](docs/install.md).
> Installing into another profile / `DSH_HOME`: `.\install.ps1 -Profile work -DshHome D:\dsh-home`.
> All flags (`-Config`, `-Mode cli|manual`, `-StageDir`, `-RenderOnly`, `-SkipCompatibility`, …) and the
> nine-step flow: [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) (Chinese).

dsh-vivado README · Install：The installer does exactly three visible things: copies itself to `<DSH_HOME>\bundles\dsh-vivado`,
renders the bundle patch there from your configuration, and registers that layer in your profile
(backing up the touched files as `*.bak-<date>` first). It does **not** modify your `cordis.patch.yml`,
does **not** write `~/.dsh/skills`, needs **no** administrator rights, and rolls back automatically
if any step fails.

no configuration, no MCP tools. Install **either** this **or** the full kit:

dsh-vivado README · When something is wrong：Run the health check first — it names the broken item and the one-line fix:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\doctor.ps1
```

The four most common cases (full list in [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](docs/troubleshooting.md), Chinese):

dsh-vivado README · When something is wrong：| Symptom | First thing to do |
|---|---|
| No `Vivado` preset after restart | Confirm you really restarted; confirm you installed into the profile you are opening (`-Profile`); then run `doctor.ps1` and read checks 9/10 |
| Preset exists but there is no `mcp__vivado__*` tool at all (including right after a DSH auto-update) | Usually the `compatibility.json` version exemption is missing → re-run `install.ps1` (**without** `-SkipCompatibility`) and restart; `doctor.ps1` check 12 names it explicitly |
| `start_session` fails / Tcl reports `File not found` | Almost always a **non-ASCII path**; `doctor.ps1` check 5 names the offending config key |
| `xdc_lint` / `get_cdc_report` details are truncated | The optional `patches/vivado-mcp` patches are not applied (they are never applied automatically) — see [`patches/vivado-mcp/README.md`](patches/vivado-mcp/README.md) |

dsh-vivado README · When something is wrong：Three rules worth remembering up front: **restart after any config change**, **every Vivado path must be
ASCII**, **only one Vivado process at a time**.

dsh-vivado README · Version tiers：`vivado_version` in `config.yml` selects which set of version truths the assistant is told:

| Tier | What you get |
|---|---|
| `2023.1` (anything `< 2025.2`) | Measured facts for this tier: Tcl 8.5.14, `open_project -noprogress` does not exist, ILA `C_DATA_DEPTH` minimum is 1024, `report_*` arguments as of 2023.1 |
| `2025.2+` | **Nothing is measured**: every version-dependent fact must be probed before use, and labelled as measured when it is reported |

dsh-vivado README · Version tiers：Evidence for each cell, the probe commands and a re-probe checklist for a new machine:
[`docs/version-matrix.md`](docs/version-matrix.md) (Chinese).

dsh-vivado README · Uninstall：```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1

dsh-vivado README · restart the host afterwards：```

It unbinds this layer from the profile (from the install-time backup, or an equivalent precise removal),
deletes the copy under `bundles\dsh-vivado`, and leaves your own plugin rows and skill directories alone.
For the manual, line-by-line rollback (and to keep the staged copy): [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md).

dsh-vivado README · Repository layout：```text
dsh-vivado/
  package.json              bundle manifest (a configuration-only DSH bundle)
  install.ps1  uninstall.ps1  doctor.ps1  lib/   install, uninstall, health check
  config.example.yml        config template (the installer turns it into config.yml)

> There is deliberately **no** `cordis.patch.yml` in the repository: it is rendered from your machine's
> configuration and only exists after installation.
